risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a competitive market with multiple players which may result in price and margin pressure (Item 1A, p. 15) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Competition in the packaging industry can impact the company's sales and operating margins

risks.title: Regulatory Risk
risks.score_rationale: Environmental and safety regulations may impact the company's costs and operations (Item 1A, p. 15) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Environmental and safety regulations may increase costs and operational complexity for the company

risks.title: Customer Concentration
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on a few major customers which creates risk if significant contracts are lost (Item 1A, p. 15) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Loss of a major customer could have a significant impact on the company's sales and results

risks.title: Acquisition Integration Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company has completed numerous acquisitions which creates integration and synergy risks (Item 1A, p. 15) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Integration of acquisitions can be complex and require significant resources

risks.title: Operational Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company's operations may be affected by production, quality or safety issues (Item 1A, p. 15) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Operational issues can impact product quality and availability as well as the company's reputation

risks.title: Debt and Leverage Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company uses financial leverage to finance operations which may increase risks in case of financial difficulties (Item 1A, p. 15) (score par défaut, à affiner)
risks.summary: Debt and financial leverage may increase company risk in case of financial difficulties

governance.voting_structure: Une seule classe d'actions ordinaires, 1 vote par action.
